files.explanation: No issues were found in this file. The server setup is robust, correctly handling middleware, static file serving for both uploaded videos and the React build, and API routing. The catch-all route for client-side navigation is also correctly implemented.

No issues were found in this file. The video routes are well-defined, including error handling for both fetching and uploading videos. The use of `multer` middleware for file uploads is correctly integrated, and input validation for `req.file` and `req.body.title` is present.

No issues were found in this file. The `multer` configuration is robust, including dynamic directory creation, unique filename generation, file size limits, and a comprehensive file type filter for video formats.

No issues were found in this file. The `App` component effectively manages video fetching, selection, and re-fetching upon successful uploads. State management is clear, and the use of `useCallback` for `fetchVideos` is appropriate to prevent unnecessary re-creations. Error and loading states are handled gracefully in the UI.

No issues were found in this file. The `VideoPlayer` component correctly displays the selected video, constructs the video URL, and includes a `key` prop on the `video` element to ensure proper re-rendering when the video source changes.

No issues were found in this file. The `UploadForm` component handles file and title input, manages upload state, and provides clear feedback to the user. The use of `FormData` for file uploads and proper error handling for API responses are correctly implemented.
